name: Tessera Industries Metamaterial Lock Pick Set MLP-1
product_name: Tessera Industries Metamaterial Lock Pick Set MLP-1
description: A set of lockpicking tools fabricated from programmable matter that can dynamically reconfigure their shape to match any lock profile. The MLP-1 contains three programmable matter tools that can transform from standard tension wrenches and picks to specialized decoder tools, tubular lock picks, wafer picks, and any other configuration needed for a specific lock type. The tools are controlled through a neural interface that scans the lock's keyway and automatically shapes the tool to match. Where a conventional lockpick set requires 15+ individual tools and extensive practice, the MLP-1 provides a universal solution that adapts itself to the challenge.

specifications.limitations: Cannot bypass electronic locks — mechanical only

story_hooks: A lock thought to be unpickable was defeated in under 10 seconds — the only tool capable of that feat is an MLP-1 with its auto-scan feature, and fewer than 100 units exist.
A Tessera insider has leaked the programmable matter blueprint for lock pick configurations — anyone with access to a programmable matter fabricator can now produce MLP-1 equivalent tools.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, minimalist carrying case with three pen-sized metallic instruments. The tools appear liquid-smooth, with a faintly iridescent surface that shifts subtly under light. They rest in custom foam cutouts within a matte-black composite case, each tool topped with a small neural interface contact node.
physical_description.weight_description: Pocket-friendly and easily carried; negligible burden despite sophisticated internals
physical_description.primary_material: Tessera programmable matter (tools); carbon-composite case with impact-absorbing polymers
physical_description.finish: Tools exhibit a liquid-metallic sheen with subtle color-shift properties (grey to dark silver gradient). Case has textured non-slip coating with soft-touch grip areas
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal-black case with gunmetal-grey tools; accent nodes glow faint cyan when powered
physical_description.interface_elements: Three contact nodes (one per tool) for neural interface link; subtle LED status indicator on case lid showing battery percentage; micro USB charging port recessed into case corner; faint holographic display window showing lock-type readout when active
distinctive_features: Programmable matter surface ripples subtly when reconfiguring
Cyan neural interface nodes emit faint bioluminescent glow during lock scanning
Tools maintain slight fluidity at molecular level — visible as shimmer at edges
Holographic lock-profile schematic floats above open case lid during operation

physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Embossed 'Tessera Industries' logo on case lid; 'MLP-1' serial designation; small 'Vasquez Biocompatible Materials' certification stamp; Φ pricing label on underside
physical_description.condition_typical: Case shows minor micro-scratches from pocket carry and field work; tools maintain pristine surface unless in active reconfiguration state; faint heat signature visible during extended use
